subject: Open Source Shiny Server Error: "Can't remove headers after they are sent"

messages.subject: Open Source Shiny Server Error: "Can't remove headers after they are sent"
parts:
I'm using the open source Shiny server and have recently seen several crashes with the error  code "Can't remove headers after they are sent", which is a javascript error. The log is relatively uninformative (it specifies a javascript error, but not the app provoking it). As a result, I don't know where the error arises, presumably in the auto-generated javascript somewhere. Any suggestions or debugging hints would be appreciated.

Thanks

A. Sharma
